shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && cat app/page.tsx && cat app/layout.tsx && cat components/request-metadata.tsx && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 4 'connection\\(\\).*new Date|connection\\(\\).*Math.random|## Enable Cache Components|synchronous IO' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started -g '*.md' | head -160"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- next.config.ts app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && cat tsconfig.json && rg -n 'partialPrefetching' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference -g '*.md' | head -50 && rg -n 'partialPrefetching\\??:' node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json tsconfig.json && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md && cat node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/partialPrefetching.md | sed -n '1,90p'"
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- package.json tsconfig.json .gitignore && stat -c '%n %y' package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json next-env.d.ts .next"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
if Path('.next').exists():
    shutil.rmtree('.next')
for name in ('next-env.d.ts', 'package-lock.json'):
    path = Path(name)
    if path.exists():
        path.unlink()
PY
git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'instant\\s*=\\s*false|dynamic\\s*=\\s*[\"'\"'](force-dynamic|error|force-static)' app || true && git diff -- app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx next.config.ts && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'instant|force-dynamic|force-static' app || true; git diff -- app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx next.config.ts; git status --short"
